$comment: CF2A-01 pass-7 Wave 1 · the canonical group claim (CT-10 request body). This schema is the ONLY home of the member bound: M4 and the register repeat the number and declare none of their own. The bound, the ordering literal and the object-id form are all schema-enforced, so a 257-member claim, a paraphrased ordering or an abbreviated object id cannot be represented at all.
title: cf.board-group-claim.v1

board_revision.description: Normal object id: 40 or 64 lowercase hex. Never a nested {algorithm,value} object, never abbreviated, never flagged.

ordering.const: created_seq ASC, id ASC; dependencies must be settled; correction retains its original worker
ordering.description: One literal. A paraphrase is a second ordering; a request carrying a different literal is refused before any candidate tree is built.

claims.description: The single member bound lives here. A wider claim is a different record, not a larger claim.

created_seq.description: Immutable board creation sequence; the primary ordering term.

claim_generation.description: 0 for a claim on a task that does not yet exist.
